capabilities: Suggest tags with fuzzy matching in frontmatter
Autocomplete tags while typing in properties
extras: The README notes a known issue: the hacky highlighting implementation may break on tags containing special characters like < or >, and invites pull requests.
intentEvidence: Based on the Frontmatter Tag Suggest plugin
motivation: The author built it because adding fuzzy search to the original plugin would change its behavior for users who prefer exact matching.
problem: When typing tags in frontmatter, suggestions only appear on exact prefixes, so typos or partial matches miss tags the user already has.

relations.evidence: This plugin has been made because fuzzy search would change the functionality of the original plugin

summary: Fuzzy-matching autocomplete for tags inside frontmatter, based on the Frontmatter Tag Suggest plugin.
